onboarding.title: Create your free crew profile in 30 seconds
onboarding.subtitle: Join Kerala's dedicated AV & event technician network. Get discovered by event organizers and production houses.
onboarding.step1Desc: We'll send an OTP to verify your WhatsApp/mobile number.
onboarding.step3Desc: Choose all categories you work in. Select specialisations below each role.
onboarding.step4Desc: Where are you primarily based for event work in Kerala?
onboarding.step5Desc: Enter your name to complete onboarding. You can add more portfolio and bio details anytime.
onboarding.consentTerms: I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
onboarding.consentConduct: I agree to professional acceptable behaviour on CrewHive.
onboarding.successDesc: Your searchable profile is now live. Complete optional details anytime to get top priority in searches.

dashboard.title: Crew Dashboard
dashboard.underReviewDesc: Your profile is undergoing standard verification. You can continue updating your profile and toggling availability.
dashboard.autoExpiredNotice: Your 7-day availability window expired. Reconfirm to show up in recruiter searches.
dashboard.noRequests: No requests yet. Switch availability on to be found by event organizers.
dashboard.missedRequestsAlert: You have missed or declined several recent availability requests. Would you like to switch your availability off so organizers know you are busy?

availability.whyLocationDesc: CrewHive matches you with nearby events in Kerala based on coarse city-level location. We never track your continuous trail, nor share your exact coordinates.
availability.coarsePrivacyNote: Strict privacy: Coarse city-level matching only. No continuous GPS tracking.
availability.locationDenied: Location permission was denied. You can select your manual city below without any disruption.

requests.title: Booking & Availability Requests
requests.subtitle: Respond quickly to recruiters looking for crew in Kerala.
requests.confirmAccept: You accepted this request. The recruiter will be notified.
requests.expiredNotice: This request has passed its response deadline.

profile.title: Edit Crew Profile
profile.subtitle: Complete your profile to increase your visibility to top Kerala event organizers.
profile.name: Full Name
profile.photoUploadHelp: Tap to upload photo (under 5MB). A clear face picture gets 3x more bookings.
profile.dayRateHelp: Expected rate per working day in Rupees.
profile.rateVisibleLabel: Make day rate visible to recruiters in search results
profile.ratePrivateNote: When off, rate is kept private and negotiated directly.
profile.associationPendingBadge: Verification Pending — Badges are awarded only after association confirmation
